exposure: initial devascularization of tumor feeding vessels
cohort: The guidelines concern the treatment and follow up of neonates and infants with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT).
finding: These are the first guidelines for Sacrococcygeal Teratoma (SCT) established in Japan, aiming to improve the prognosis and quality of life for SCT patients by developing therapeutic strategies and follow-up recommendations.
mod_finding: The guidelines addressed the efficacy of cesarean section in the context of sacrococcygeal teratoma management.
